gold.user: As a project manager, I want to retrieve all status categories in Jira to better understand the workflow states available for my projects.
gold.ideal: The API should return a list of all status categories, including their IDs and names, allowing me to see how tasks are organized within different categories.

gold.user: As a developer, I need to fetch details of a specific status category by its ID to ensure that I am using the correct category in my API calls.
gold.ideal: The API should return the details of the specified status category, including its ID, name, and description, so I can confirm its properties before proceeding with my implementation.
